Name: Boutique Hotline
Author: ragdez212121
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Boutique Hotline[/b][/size]
[i]Call a boutique from your telephone.[/i][/center]

A rotating clothing catalogue built into the game's own shop menu. Wedding attire always in stock, festival outfits that appear right when you need them, and prismatic pieces at genuinely absurd prices.

No new NPC. No new building. Just pick up your telephone.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Telephone access.[/b] Choose [i]Boutique[/i] alongside Robin, Clint, Pierre, Marnie and Gus.[/*]
[*][b]Rotating stock.[/b] Refreshes weekly or daily. Guaranteed slots per category, so you never get a week with no pants.[/*]
[*][b]Wedding attire, always.[/b] A curated head-to-toe set: bridal veil, tiara, top hat, bridal shirt, tuxedos, dresses, skirts and crystal shoes. In stock every day, because you shouldn't plan your wedding around a shop rotation.[/*]
[*][b]Festival themes.[/b] Eight vanilla festivals, each with a hand-picked outfit set shown at the top of the shop. Goes on sale two days early so you arrive dressed for it.[/*]
[*][b]Prismatic pieces.[/b] Detected using the game's own IsPrismatic flag. Always available, minimum 500,000g.[/*]
[*][b]Basics never rotate out.[/b] Plain shirts, farmer pants, dresses and skirts.[/*]
[*][b]Full config menu.[/b] Everything adjustable in-game via Generic Mod Config Menu, applied instantly.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Any mod that adds clothing in [b]vanilla format[/b] (Data/Shirts, Data/Pants, Data/hats, Data/Boots) is picked up automatically. No patches, no config, no compatibility list.

Verified with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]: its Galdoran Knight Boots and Galdoran Mage Boots appear in the catalogue with zero extra code.

[b]Not supported:[/b] Fashion Sense. It uses its own framework rather than the vanilla clothing assets.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Optional but recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Buy a telephone from Robin's carpentry shop, place it, and use it.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
With GMCM: [b]Options → Boutique Hotline[/b]. Without it: edit config.json.
[list]
[*]Rotation days: 7 (set 1 for daily)[/*]
[*]Items per rotation: 25 (set 0 to sell the whole catalogue)[/*]
[*]Guaranteed slots: 10 shirts / 6 pants / 5 hats / 4 boots[/*]
[*]Minimum price: 2,500g[/*]
[*]Boots and hats multipliers: 1.5 / 1.2[/*]
[*]Prismatic minimum: 500,000g[/*]
[*]Festival lead days: 2[/*]
[*]Shared catalogue: on (off = each player gets their own rotation)[/*]
[/list]Wedding sets, festival sets and always-in-stock basics are editable ID lists, so you can add clothing from other mods to any of them.

[spoiler][b]FAQ[/b]

[b]Do I need a telephone?[/b] Yes. Buy it from Robin and place it in your house.

[b]Where are the dresses?[/b] In Stardew, dresses and skirts live in the pants category. They're in the catalogue and always in stock.

[b]Why is everything named "Shirt"?[/b] That's vanilla. Those are the dyeable base shirts. Dye them at Emily's.

[b]Multiplayer?[/b] Each farmer can call the boutique. With shared catalogue on, everyone sees the same stock.

[b]Something broke.[/b] Upload your log to smapi.io/log and post the link in the comments.[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Translations[/b][/size]
English and Spanish included. Translations welcome, files are in i18n/.

[size=4][b]Permissions[/b][/size]
This mod only reads clothing data the player already has installed. It redistributes no assets from the game or from any other mod. Code is MIT licensed. Compatibility patches welcome.
